title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
About HiredBuddy

At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.

This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
  • Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
  • Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.

title: Healthcare Virtual Assistant Athena EMR Experience
description:
Overview

Snapscale is seeking a highly skilled Healthcare Virtual Assistant to support day-to-day U.S. clinic operations in a remote setup and ensure a seamless patient experience. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and hands-on experience in U.S. healthcare processes. The ideal candidate must have proven expertise in EMR systems, specifically Athena EMR, and the ability to manage multiple clinical and administrative tasks efficiently while working remotely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Verify patient benefits and insurance coverage accurately and efficiently
  • Reactivate past patients and maintain engagement through consistent follow-ups
  • Handle inbound calls and assist patients with inquiries professionally and empathetically
  • Conduct appointment confirmations, reminders, and outbound follow-ups
  • Schedule and reschedule patient appointments using Athena EMR
  • Maintain and update patient records in Athena EMR (required)
  • Perform medical chart scrubbing to ensure accuracy and completeness of patient data
  • Process and manage prior authorizations following payer and clinic guidelines
  • Handle prescription refills in accordance with clinic protocols
  • Audit laboratory results and follow up on missing or pending reports
  • Support monitoring and coordination of clinic workflows in a remote setting, including virtual systems and tools
  • Minimum 6 months to 1 year of hands-on experience with Athena EMR (required)
  • Experience working with US based clinics and/or health insurance providers
  • Experience in insurance verification, patient coordination, and inbound call handling
  • Experience in medical chart scrubbing and prior authorization processing
  • Experience in refill processing, lab result auditing, and follow-up coordination

title: Software Engineer Linux OS (m/w/d)
description:
Dein Ziel

Als Software Engineer Linux OS bist Du verantwortlich für das Betriebssystem unseres Gateways. Du gestaltest die Grundlage für ein sicheres, stabiles und skalierbares Ökosystem, das den Betrieb, die Überwachung und Aktualisierung unserer Geräteflotte ermöglicht. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unsere Anwendungen und trägst aktiv zur Digitalisierung der Energienetze bei!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und wartest ein sicheres und modulares Linux-Betriebssystem für unsere Gateways.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Frameworks und Schnittstellen zur Überwachung und Aktualisierung der Geräteflotte.
  • Du integrierst Lösungen zur Geräteidentifikation, -authentifizierung und -autorisierung, um höchste Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.
  • Das Thema Linux OS treibst Du aktiv voran und bringst technische Weiterentwicklungen eigenständig von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungsworkflows mit, z. B. Versionskontrolle mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisiertes Testing und Code Reviews.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Linux-Betriebssystemen und Softwarearchitekturen bringst Du mit.
  • Der Umgang mit Tools wie Yocto zur Erstellung und Anpassung von Linux-Distributionen ist dir vertraut.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in aktuellen Programmiersprachen wie C++ und Python
  • Im Bereich Docker und Containerisierung verfügst du über sehr gute Kenntnisse.
  • Mit der Konzeption sicherer Systeme, z. B. durch Threat Modelling

title: Working Student, Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
description:
Mission

Support the Data & Analytics team in its day-to-day work, from pipelines to Data Apps and Reports to answering business questions.


Role Overview

As a Working Student in the Data & Analytics team, you will work alongside our analysts on what the week actually needs: a pipeline that has to keep running, a Data App a team is waiting for, a question someone needs answered. You will work in Knime every day, on things people across the company use. This is a role with real ownership: you get clearly scoped tasks and regular check-ins, and between them you work independently.


Responsibilities

  • Support the team day to day: take on the analysis, Report, or fix the week calls for, and see it through

  • Build and maintain data ingestion workflows, and keep scheduled pipelines running as our data sources change

  • Build Data Apps and Reports that teams across Knime use to answer their own questions

  • Research questions other teams bring us, and come back with an answer they can act on

  • Improve existing workflows, Data Apps, and Reports: performance, cleanup, and documentation

  • Own your tasks end to end: ask the scoping questions up front, execute independently, and hand over results clearly


Requirements

  • Enrolled at a university or Hochschule in Berlin, based in Berlin, with at least 12 months of study remaining

  • Available at least 16 hours a week, and on site in our Kreuzberg office two days a week

  • Working knowledge of Knime and data science fundamentals

  • Solid SQL and database basics
